entries.zh: 责罚（责打惩处）；亦通「惩罚」
entries.en: to punish, chastise; to reprove and punish
entries.notes: 汉字栏为[疑:責罰/懲罰]，据官话对音 chiè fâ（責罰）与闽南音写 chēng hūan 定为責罰义；闽南栏另见 güenchŷ 一形未能确解。

entries.en: punishment, penalty; to punish
punishment, penalty

entries.zh: 除（除灭；施刑处死已判罪者）
entries.en: to do away with, eliminate; to execute the condemned (castigar al sentenciado: matarle)
entries.notes: 西语限定语有[疑:matalle/mahalle]，取 matarle（杀之）解，即处决已判刑者；汉字「除」取除灭义与之相配。

entries.en: to chasten, discipline (punish so as to amend)

entries.zh: 惩创（惩治使之改过自新）
entries.en: to chastise, punish (so as to reform)
to discipline, admonish; warning punishment
to reprove, censure, condemn (the culprit)

entries.zh: 责罚（责打惩处，以正其非）
entries.en: to punish, chastise; to correct

entries.zh: 剥削（明末旧义：克剥、勒索；或指罚剥其财）
entries.en: to exploit, extort, fleece; (lit.) to strip, flay
entries.notes: 汉字/闽南/官话三栏一致为「剝削」，但与西语词头 castigar/corregir（惩罚、改正）语义不合，疑栏位错置；字义按三中栏取克剥勒索义。

entries.en: to blame, reproach, scold (someone)
entries.notes: 西语限定语「a stios」未能确解，然汉字/闽南/官话三栏一致为责备义，不受影响。

entries.zh: 烹调（烹煮调制食物）；〔存疑：与西语词头「言语责罚」全然不合，疑原稿条目错位，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to cook, to dress food (per the Chinese columns; the Spanish headword castigar de palabra, to punish verbally, does not match — probable entry misalignment in the original)
entries.notes: 汉字/闽南/官话三栏均为烹調义，但官话对音 piān 与「調」(tiáo) 音不合（疑或为「煎」），且与西语词头语义全然相悖，语义无法定夺。

entries.en: to punish with the cangue; to chastise
entries.notes: 汉字栏为[疑:枷責/加責]，据闽南 güe chēg、官话 guīa chiē 与西语体罚语境取枷责义；西语「coſtando a natabla」未能确解。

entries.en: to condemn, reproach, censure
to condemn and punish (the culprit)

entries.zh: 拟罚（拟罪议刑，议定处罚）
entries.en: to assess and decree a punishment
penal law, criminal code
strict, severe law; to punish with rigor
entries.notes: 汉字栏为[疑:嚴法/叒法]，据闽南 giām hûar、官话 ngiên fâ（严法）取严法义。

entries.zh: 擅罚（擅自施罚）；〔存疑：字或为「變自」，释义未能定夺〕
entries.en: to punish on one's own authority, without the act having been committed (Chinese reading uncertain: 擅自 vs 變自)
entries.notes: 汉字栏为[疑:擅自/變自]，闽南 pièn chū 与官话 pièn zū 皆近「變/便」而不近「擅」，西语「ſin ſer fuech（事未成而罚）」语境下两候选字义均未能定夺。

entries.en: heavy punishment, severe reproof
entries.notes: 西语限定语「peradamto」未能确解（疑抄写讹误），汉字/闽南/官话三栏一致取重责义。

entries.zh: 除民害（流放窜逐，为民除害）
entries.en: to banish, exile; to rid the people of a scourge

entries.zh: 儆戒（惩一儆百，以惩示戒）
entries.en: to warn, admonish; punishment as a warning (so that the offender may be brought to repentance)
entries.notes: 汉字栏为[疑:儆戒/敬戒]，据闽南 güēy cāy、官话 güèng güīy 取儆戒义；西语「p^a q̃ caiga en la ĝa」之 ĝa 疑为 gracia 缩写（罚使归于恩宠/悔改）。
